implementation: Pure Python port of SDK 2.2.0 x-mcp-header declaration scanning and primitive header construction. Preserve properties-only reachability, all excluded subschema keywords, first-fault diagnostics, case-insensitive name uniqueness, JS property enumeration and value-path semantics, primitive/unsafe-number decisions, UTF-8 surrogate replacement and empty/whitespace/sentinel Base64 encoding.

paired.scope: Execute the pinned SDK's actual scanXMcpHeaderDeclarations and buildMcpParamHeaders exports against the same schemas/arguments. Exact raw declarations, faults and header values compare, including all 18 excluded keywords, malformed nested schemas, numeric keys, array arguments, Unicode and unsafe integers.

native.scope: Original corpus plus focused empty/Unicode/whitespace/sentinel output and invalid-declaration atomic rejection. Initial test's estimated corpus count corrected from 284 to the actual 275; implementation and successful Source pairing unchanged.

cleanup.scope: All owned initial/final targeted workspaces/home/tmp removed; paired observations and command/log/XML retained.

limitations: This verifies the pure SDK rules. Client list filtering, per-request header integration and mismatch recovery are the next consumer contract.
No full regression, production pin promotion, release or actual Windows 7 qualification claimed.
